# Muhammad Royhan

> Senior Fullstack Engineer and Team Lead — seven years and three promotions at
> one company. Backend and frontend, with a focus on systems that have to be
> correct under real-world constraints: idempotency, auditability, and
> regulatory correctness, not just feature delivery.

Available in two languages. English (`/`) is written for an international
audience and carries the long-form narrative; Indonesian (`/id`) is a shorter,
fact-first register written for Indonesian hiring practice — not a translation
of the English text.

## Background

- 2019 — Junior Software Engineer. ERP build and an inherited rental marketplace.
- 2022 — Senior Software Engineer. Employee credit system for a rural credit
  bank (BPR), owned from first commit through to handover.
- 2023 — Team Lead, legacy maintenance across already-shipped systems.
- 2024–2026 — Team Lead. Payroll system: internal in 2024, extended for a client
  at 800+ employees, shipped June 2026 and still maintained.

## Pages

- [Home](/) · [Beranda](/id): five-act career narrative, tech stack, contact.
  Also embeds "Ask about Royhan" — an interactive Q&A widget in the hero,
  grounded in this site's own content (RAG over the case studies, essays,
  and career narrative below), plus a static FAQ section with the same
  answers for crawlers that don't run the widget.
- [Work](/work) · [Proyek](/id/work): case studies of production systems.
- [Payroll system](/work/payroll-system): flagship case study — scope
  resolution engine, idempotent payroll runs, PPh 21 TER / BPJS / PP 58/2023,
  generic audit trail across ten entities.
- [Employee credit, BPR](/work/core-banking-bpr): first end-to-end ownership;
  multi-tenant lending portals for bank, employer and borrower, ending in a
  generated credit agreement; design driven by the handover constraint.
- [Rental marketplace](/work/rental-marketplace): inherited mid-build;
  time-driven order state machine, two courier integrations behind one status
  model, promo refund logic for partial cancellation.
- [Writing](/writing) · [Tulisan](/id/writing): essays connecting systems
  thinking and Stoic philosophy to engineering decisions.
- [Resume (PDF)](/royhan-resume.pdf)

## Stack

React.js, Next.js, Flutter, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, NestJS,
Sequelize.js, MySQL, AWS SQS, Docker.
